about.title: About us
about.subtitle: An Omani trading and contracting company supplying quality products and dependable services to homes and businesses.
story: Wadi Al Ghubaitah Trade & Cont. began as a local trading business serving families, shops and builders in our community. Over the years we have grown into a trusted supplier of home appliances, electrical goods, tools, building materials and household essentials — and a contractor that customers call on for fit-out and maintenance work.

Many of our customers told us the same thing: they wanted to see what was in stock, compare prices and order without a trip across town. This online store is our answer. It brings our range, our prices and our service together in one place, with delivery to every governorate in the Sultanate.
about.vision: To be one of Oman's leading trading and contracting companies through innovation, service and digital transformation.
about.mission: To give customers high-quality products and services they can rely on, through efficient operations and the thoughtful use of technology.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about ordering, delivery, payment and returns.
faq.stillTitle: Can't find what you're looking for?
faq.stillBody: Our customer service team is happy to help.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Add products to your cart, choose Checkout, enter your delivery address, pick a delivery method and pay by card or cash on delivery. You'll receive an order number in the format WG-XXXXX.

items.q: How can I track my order?
items.a: Sign in and open My orders. Each order shows a timeline from Placed through Confirmed, Processing, Shipped and Out for delivery to Delivered, and you'll receive a notification at every step.
Yes, while the order is still Placed or Confirmed. Open the order in My orders and choose Cancel order. Once it is being processed, please contact us.
We deliver to all eleven governorates of the Sultanate of Oman.
Standard delivery is OMR 1.500 and free on orders over OMR 20.000 (after discounts). Express delivery is OMR 3.500.
Standard delivery takes 2–4 working days. Express orders arrive the next working day in Muscat and within 1–2 working days elsewhere.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Debit and credit cards, and cash on delivery. In this demonstration store, card payments are simulated and no real money is taken.

items.q: Are your prices inclusive of VAT?
items.a: Product prices are shown before VAT. Oman's 5% VAT is added to your merchandise and delivery at checkout, and itemised on your invoice.

items.q: How do I use a coupon?
items.a: Enter the code in the Coupon field at checkout and choose Apply. The discount and any minimum order are checked before you pay.
Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 14 days of delivery. Building materials cut or mixed to order cannot be returned.

items.q: Do products come with a warranty?
items.a: Most appliances, tools and fittings carry the manufacturer's warranty, shown in the product specifications. Keep your invoice as proof of purchase.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Wadi Al Ghubaitah Trade & Cont. collects, uses and protects your personal data.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Wadi Al Ghubaitah Trade & Cont. (“we”, “us”) operates this online store from Muscat, Sultanate of Oman. We handle personal data in line with Oman's Personal Data Protection Law (Royal Decree 6/2022).

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Account details: your name, email address, mobile number and password (stored only as a secure hash).
Order details: delivery addresses, the products you buy, and payment records. For card payments we keep only the last four digits of your card — never the full number or security code.
Messages you send us through the Contact page, and basic technical data such as your IP address to protect accounts against misuse.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: To process and deliver your orders, send order and payment notifications, provide customer support, prevent fraud and meet our legal and tax obligations. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
body: Only with service providers who help us run the store — such as delivery partners and payment processors — and only as far as needed to serve you, or where the law requires it.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Order and invoice records are kept for as long as Omani tax law requires. Other data is kept while your account is active and deleted or anonymised afterwards.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can access and update your details from your account at any time, and ask us to correct or delete your data or to stop processing it, subject to our legal obligations. Contact info@wadialghubaitah.test.

sections.heading: Security
body: We use encrypted connections, hashed passwords, role-based access for staff and login protection against repeated failed attempts.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in and remember your language, theme and cart. We do not use advertising cookies.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: The terms that apply when you use this website and buy from Wadi Al Ghubaitah Trade & Cont.

sections.heading: About these terms
body: By using this website or placing an order, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully. We may update them from time to time; the version published when you order applies to that order.

sections.heading: Your account
body: You must give accurate information and keep your password confidential. You are responsible for activity on your account. We may suspend accounts that are misused.

sections.heading: Prices and VAT
body: Prices are in Omani rials (OMR) and shown before VAT. Value Added Tax at 5% is added at checkout. We try to keep prices accurate; if an obvious pricing error occurs, we will contact you before processing the order.

sections.heading: Orders and payment
body: Your order is an offer to buy. It is accepted when we confirm it. Payment can be made by card or cash on delivery. This website is a demonstration: card payments are simulated and no real transactions take place.

sections.heading: Delivery
body: We deliver to addresses in the Sultanate of Oman. Delivery times are estimates. Someone must be available to receive the order; for cash on delivery, payment is due on hand-over.

sections.heading: Cancellations and returns
body: You may cancel online while an order is Placed or Confirmed. Unused items in original packaging may be returned within 14 days of delivery, except items made, cut or mixed to order. Refunds are made to the original payment method.

sections.heading: Warranty
body: Products carry the manufacturer's warranty where stated. Your statutory rights under Oman's Consumer Protection Law are not affected.

sections.heading: Reviews
body: Only customers who have received a product may review it. Reviews must be honest and lawful; we may hide reviews that break these rules.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Sultanate of Oman, and the courts of Muscat have jurisdiction.
